fact: The 2024 FNAU-led booklet describes GRB 2.0 as digitising all budget-resource management processes of local authorities, developed in the Bizerte e-payment project with the platform hosted in a state-approved public data centre and funded under the French Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs' 2023-2024 call for projects.
title: Territoires numériques responsables & inclusifs: synthèse du cycle de webinaires
publisher: FNAU et partenaires (Projet de coopération, DCTCIV, Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires Etrangères)
